lines.text: Textbook: I need to get a flu injection.
Natives say: I need to get a flu shot.
In everyday American English, it's a flu shot.
Shot! Many people get a flu shot every fall.

data.wrong: I need to get a flu injection.
data.right: I need to get a flu shot.
data.why: In everyday American English, it's a flu shot.
data.aha: A shot is any injection in casual talk!

quiz.stem: Many people get a flu ___ every fall.
